scope: Bounded public building reads, public-only cache and optional validated read fallback, independent Home/Money degradation, and the migrated governed release launcher. No financial program, authority, Secret, NetworkPolicy or other-product deployment change.

preReleaseChecks.independentBackendAndUiReviews: No surviving findings after corrections; signed retry/reconciliation, auth-read abort forwarding, EVM recovery and monotonic freshness boundaries reviewed.
preReleaseChecks.offlineLauncherCheckScope: Tcl parsing and prompt admission, dispatcher rejection matrix, private-copy hash admission and tamper rejection; operational exec/spawn/Kubernetes/release paths stubbed, no cluster access.
preReleaseChecks.hardenedImage: Actual published amd64 image: uid 1000, read-only root, drop ALL, no-new-privileges, private paths absent, bundled public-data hashes matched; public routes 200, unauthenticated rent 401, paused account/retention routes 404.

actualImageCacheExercise.environment: Published image running locally with real public Solana devnet data, not hosted production and not a synthetic RPC fixture.

diagnosis.reportedBeforeChange: Default /api/building returned 503 after approximately nine seconds. The RPC/configuration flags in /api/status were not health probes.
diagnosis.defaultReader: Solana when a house manifest is configured; explicit network=robinhood selects the separate legacy reader. Runtime failure metadata now identifies solana-devnet.
confirmedUiCauses: A building network read could replace the whole local-stakes screen with an error.
Home initially gated independent content on completion of both journey and listing reads.
Display reads lacked the new bounded abort/cache behavior.

ownerConfirmedCause.source: Owner's Helius dashboard, reported through Main on 12 October

cancelledClassifier.sourceReview: Conditional SOURCEPASS for exact frozen artifacts
cancelledClassifier.reason: Owner cancelled the approved diagnostic before execution because the dashboard established quota exhaustion.

diagnosis.limitation: The original provider HTTP response was not observed in-pod. Earlier admission failures and the later explicitly cancelled probe did not read the live Secret or call getHealth. Owner-confirmed Helius quota exhaustion is recorded separately; no particular original HTTP code or NetworkPolicy fault is claimed.
diagnosis.fallbackReason: No owner-controlled secondary key was available. The documented public dRPC candidate returned an error and the Solana-listed Ankr candidate required credentials. No unverified endpoint or borrowed credential was installed.
diagnosis.financialTransport: Preparation, signing, broadcasting, private positions and reconciliation retain the configured primary SOLANA_RPC_URL; public read fallback cannot repair an unavailable financial primary.

freshJudgeLiveAcceptance.authentication: Normal hosted Create account UI with a new virtual platform passkey in an isolated browser context; no injected auth or API signup bypass. Private passkey material saved separately and never included in this evidence.

building.genuineOutageUi: Testnetz-RPC derzeit nicht erreichbar; illustrative map, House/Workshop/Agri-PV picker, contextual rows and earlier Robinhood lanes remain available. Unknown balances and income are dashes, not zeros.
building.independentPicker: Agri-PV opened normally at 390px with its existing illustrative/model/not-an-investment labels; no horizontal overflow. Its simulated amounts are not live income.

moneyRegression.reason: The hosted Solana read remained unavailable and no usable public snapshot or private balance could be verified. No financial action was forced through the unavailable state. A successful configured-primary read is required before an honest new transaction proof; older receipts are not relabelled as revision-41 verification.

browserLocalFixtures.warning: These are explicitly labelled browser-local QA simulations, not production decisions, live income or upstream-outage evidence. Only GET display reads were intercepted; no financial POST or private balance was mocked and no transaction was performed.

homeTimeout.result: The existing Browse other homes row remained available and opened real listings alongside the bounded error and Retry control.

stalePublicSnapshot.result: Displayed 1.5 test USDC only as a saved/not-current public reading, with its verification time and the new-financial-actions-paused explanation. Private balances remained unknown.

expiredPublicSnapshot.result: Removed the expired amount and staker count, showing unknown values and Public income snapshot expired. The private read was still pending at capture; this is not private-RPC health evidence.

browserLocalFixtures.cleanup: Each fixture handler was removed in finally and request interception disabled. The QA banners disappeared on normal reload. Real Home returned and a subsequent unmodified Money view again showed genuine unavailable/unknown state rather than the synthetic amount.
harnessCorrections: The first Home fixture wait incorrectly expected automatically expanded listings; it timed out. Source inspection showed the existing Browse other homes row is intentionally used while tenancy state is unknown. The corrected case opens that row.
An Agri-PV wait expected wording not used by the existing model; actual selected content was then inspected. Neither selector error was labelled an app failure.
A separate fresh-profile browser launcher failed before any production navigation. The account acceptance used a new isolated context in the working managed browser instead.

screenshots.note: Full-page mobile captures retain the fixed navigation at the original viewport boundary; the separate genuine detail capture shows the card in an ordinary scrolled 390px viewport.
